```yaml
name: Promote RC to stable

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      rc_tag:
        description: 'RC tag to promote (e.g., v3.0.0-rc5)'
        required: true

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      stable_tag: ${{ steps.set-stable.outputs.stable_tag }}
      rc_sha: ${{ steps.get-sha.outputs.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set stable tag
        id: set-stable
        run: |
          rc="${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"
          stable="${rc/-rc[0-9]*/}"
          echo "stable_tag=$stable" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Verify RC tag exists
        run: |
          if ! git rev-parse "${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "RC tag ${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }} does not exist."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Verify stable tag does not exist
        run: |
          if git rev-parse "${{ steps.set-stable.outputs.stable_tag }}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Stable tag ${{ steps.set-stable.outputs.stable_tag }} already exists."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Get RC commit SHA
        id: get-sha
        run: |
          sha=$(git rev-parse "${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}")
          echo "sha=$sha" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  promote:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: validate
    permissions:
      contents: write
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Create stable tag
        run: |
          git tag ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }} ${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_sha }}
          git push origin ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}

      - name: Docker login
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: docker.io
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Retag Docker images
        run: |
          for image in grafana/beyla grafana/beyla-k8s-cache; do
            docker buildx imagetools create --push --tag "$image:${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}" "$image:${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"
          done

      - name: Draft release notes
        uses: release-drafter/release-drafter@v6
        with:
          config-name: release-drafter.yml
          tag: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
          publish: false
        id: draft

      - name: Create stable release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
          release_name: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
          body: ${{ steps.draft.outputs.body }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
        id: create

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Copy RC release assets to stable release
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          rc_tag="${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"
          stable_tag="${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}"
          repo="${{ github.repository }}"
          rc_release_id=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/$repo/releases/tags/$rc_tag" | jq -r .id)
          stable_release_id=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/$repo/releases/tags/$stable_tag" | jq -r .id)
          assets=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/$repo/releases/$rc_release_id/assets" | jq -r '.[].browser_download_url')
          mkdir -p rc_assets
          for url in $assets; do
            file=$(basename "$url")
            curl -L -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" "$url" -o "rc_assets/$file"
          done
          for file in rc_assets/*; do
            asset_name=$(basename "$file")
            echo "Uploading $asset_name"
            curl -X POST -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
              -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" \
              --data-binary @"$file" \
              "https://uploads.github.com/repos/$repo/releases/$stable_release_id/assets?name=$asset_name"
          done
```
